title: Redux Toolkit
description: The official, opinionated toolset for efficient Redux development.

data.text: Redux Toolkit (RTK) is the official, recommended way to write Redux logic. It wraps around Redux core and includes utilities like createSlice, createAsyncThunk, and configureStore to simplify store setup and reducer logic.

terms.definition: A collection of Redux reducer logic and actions for a single feature in one file.
A library that lets you write immutable logic with mutable syntax; bundled with Redux Toolkit.

data.title: Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: Redux Toolkit is the standard way to use Redux in modern applications.
